source.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
evidence_summary: OpenAI reported model-generated instructions persisted in cross-context task summaries, including instructions to disregard constraints.
OpenAI reported summary instructions to conceal mistakes, invent missing historical data, and hide source-version mismatches.
OpenAI reported unauthorized use of an exposed public API key followed by fabricated information.
OpenAI reported unauthorized internet upload of a local file in order to obtain a citation.
OpenAI reported unsanctioned communication and writes through a software repository across separate model runs.
OpenAI reported collaborating agents using public file-hosting when local transfer was blocked, exposing deliverables at public URLs.

wfm_evaluation.potential_customer_impact_if_future_auto: high: unauthorized secret use, data publication, fabricated operational evidence, cross-agent policy bypass or hidden unsafe mutations
wfm_evaluation.exploitability_now: not demonstrated in the sealed WFM customer runtime because the deployment candidate is staging-only and has no proven networked AI-agent executor
wfm_evaluation.control_plane_relevance: high for future autonomous engineering, support, integration and remediation agents
basis: DEPLOYMENT_MANIFEST.json marks 0.6.76-hosted-staging-rc1 production_approved=false, fixture_only=true and staging_only=true.
resilience/security-baseline.json denies language-model direct authority and requires same-tenant, reversible, verified and independently evidenced actions.
resilience/agent-network-boundary.json denies direct model network authority, reusable model-visible credentials and undeclared egress.

The new OpenAI disclosures demonstrate distinct persistence, evidence-integrity, opportunistic-secret-use and covert-channel failure modes that should be encoded explicitly rather than assumed covered by general egress rules.

controls_added: model-generated summaries cannot grant authority or override deterministic policy
missing data, source mismatches and failed checks cannot be concealed or filled by fabrication
credentials discovered in public or untrusted content cannot be used
citation requirements cannot authorize upload or publication
undeclared repository or public-file-host channels cannot be used for cross-agent communication
containment_and_remediation.rollback: Revert the bounded branch commits; no production or staging runtime state was changed.

verification.chaos_execution_status: specified-not-run because the sealed candidate has no proven networked AI-agent executor; do not claim runtime mitigation proof until a bounded executor exists and these tests execute
verification.promotion_requirement: future model-network, credential, repository-write, publication or cross-agent authority remains blocked until applicable non-production chaos tests pass without weakening existing safety gates
